commenti.body: Incredible movie. The only thing I didn't like was when they spelled out the boy's preferences in the scene with the music teacher. Just too obvious for a movie that normally doesn't scream its intentions.
You meant the principal? I didn't mind that but I do get what you mean. I understand how it would've been better if that stayed more ambiguous.

I thought it was wonderful too ([my full thoughts here](https://boxd.it/5wKEDx). I really think it needs a rewatch because of how throughly it shifts your expectations throughout. I suspect it will play richer on repeat as you can understand every actions and its motivation. 

Koreeda was the right pick for this. His unique sense of real but heightened emotion grounds the story. In other hands it could be sensationalist, which could cheapen it. 

Also how good are the two kid actors??

I rarely rewatch films even if I really enjoyed them. But I agree that rewatching it can give you a renewed understanding of the film. And yes, i believe in other hands, it would have cheapen it. Kore-eda is such a genius. The child actors were awesome. They both captured the innocence required for their roles.
That was a beautiful review of this movie. Just read it on Letterboxd. Thank you for sharing. :)
